paper.title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents

evidence.paraphrase: Temporally extended household traces test Memory QA and embodied planning over changing world state.

adjudication_notes: 2026-09-17 scope review: Household event traces support questions and planning over temporally changing semantic states. The reviewed protocol uses semantic scene and event information; raw visual or audio inputs to the evaluated agent were not established. Retained as a stateful embodied-memory comparison. The legacy scope_status field is not a Table 2 exclusion rule.

The v2 evaluation protocol uses semantic household traces. An image input to the evaluated memory system was not established; the unsupported image secondary-modality tag and Table 2 direct CE annotation were removed. Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.18847v2, Sections 3.1–3.3 and 8.1.
